title: FDGR evidence-qualified digital-twin delivery program
description:
Purpose
Deliver FDGR as an evidence-grade, agent-native operating substrate that turns authorized drone/camera observations into immutable, uncertainty-bearing geometry and semantic digital twins. The product is the safe loop fdgr.open_session -> orient -> query/propose/compare -> commit -> watch/cancel -> verify/reconcile -> explain/handoff/doctor, not a loose set of crate APIs or a mesh generator.

Non-negotiable constitution
- Freeze semantics before implementation; create a deterministic reference path before optimized, adaptive, or model-heavy paths.
- Preserve original bytes and exact provenance. Derived assets never overwrite originals. Every coherent generation follows reserve -> materialize -> verify -> publish and exposes request durability, process acceptance, observed output, verified output, publication, and semantic completion separately.
- Make clocks, capture epochs, coordinate frames, calibration, scale, uncertainty, privacy scope, coverage, and compatibility first-class typed evidence. Never emit metric claims for relative-only or merely estimated scale. Reject non-finite numbers, invalid rotations, singular calibration, unbounded coordinates, mixed generations, and implicit frame conversions.
- Preserve Observation, Hypothesis, Resolved, Rejected, and Indeterminate. Model/caption/memory/recommendation outputs are authority-free proposals. Absence requires a coverage and detectability witness; critical assets require elevated review gates.
- Use the pinned edition-2024 nightly, a strict crate DAG, safe Rust with #![forbid(unsafe_code)], typed errors, stable IDs, canonical ordering, lower_snake_case public vocabulary, and fdgr.<name>/1 payload schemas. Shipping code forbids unwrap, expect, panic!, todo!, unimplemented!, and dbg!.
- Asupersync is the only in-process async runtime. All asynchronous work belongs to a region, accepts &Cx, and supports cancel -> drain -> reconcile -> finalize with no detached descendants. ffmpeg and model runtimes remain bounded process sidecars with sealed manifests, content-addressed inputs, no-network defaults, output validation, and descendant cleanup. Forbidden dependencies/FFI remain forbidden.
- Operate only authorized devices/accounts; begin read-only; never bypass pairing, authentication, encryption, access controls, or geographic restrictions; never expose arbitrary packet injection or flight commands.
- Project every public result through one anchor-bound Agent Turn Packet, the abstraction tower, four synchronized ledgers, objective/question graph, exactly one Decision Frame for material decisions, stable attention/epistemic debt, typed spatial handles, explicit budgets/recovery/continuations, and authority-free handoffs.

Delivery structure
The program contains nine workstreams and the exact registry packages WP-000..WP-047. Each package has contract/reference, production implementation, integration/recovery, adversarial verification, and local qualification subtasks. Work-package and task blockers reproduce registries/work_packages.toml. Registry IDs, gates, TEST families, SLOs, risks, open questions, schemas, and qualification lanes are binding inputs; prose compactness never weakens them.

Evidence and release rule
Completion requires retained deterministic fixtures, unit/property/differential tests, fault campaigns, end-to-end scripts with structured high-signal logs, input/source/toolchain/model/hardware/policy roots, output digests, timings, budgets, omissions, and terminal receipts. Same-binary semantic equality precedes performance comparison. IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS must change with earned/lost capability. Local Doodlestein receipts are the release authority; hosted CI is informational only. Negative evidence remains visible and no aggregate percentage may imply readiness.
acceptance_criteria: All 48 normative WP-000 through WP-047 packages satisfy their registered terminal gates; the dependency graph remains acyclic and registry-faithful; every advertised capability has current positive local Doodlestein receipts plus visible negative evidence for unqualified dimensions; a cold agent can orient, choose, commit, watch, verify, reconcile, and hand off without reading source or replaying a transcript; no hosted badge, model output, recommendation, memory, or derived presentation is treated as authority.

title: Workstream A: Constitution, identity, ledger, and publication foundation
description:
Purpose
Freeze machine semantics and build the deterministic trust root: registries, strict workspace, canonical identity/codec, append-only reference ledger, and crash-safe content-addressed publication. This workstream defines the vocabulary and oracles every later optimization, adapter, model, agent projection, and release receipt must reproduce.

Scope
Normative packages: WP-000..WP-004. Registered acceptance span: GATE-000..GATE-002. This epic is organizational; the WP epics and their explicit blocker edges remain the execution authority.

Cross-cutting completion rule
Every child package must preserve exact anchors, stable ordering, typed errors/recovery, immutable originals, reserve-materialize-verify-publish, Asupersync region ownership, closed dependency/unsafe policy, agent Turn Packet projection, deterministic fixtures, structured end-to-end logging, local qualification receipts, and contemporaneous IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS updates. Negative evidence and research-only boundaries remain visible.
acceptance_criteria: Every normative package in WP-000..WP-004 has a complete self-contained task decomposition, all registered predecessor edges are represented, and each package closes only on its own registered terminal gate with retained local evidence.

description:
Outcome
Freeze normative vocabulary, IDs, invariants, claims, effects, errors, schemas, and admission policies.

Why this package exists
This is the constitutional root. It must describe actual authority and negative evidence, not merely produce documents. New implementation work must first add missing prerequisite IDs/contracts here.

Required deliverables
Versioned registries for doctrine, invariants, capabilities, claims, effects, errors, schemas, ADRs, models, geometry/graph algorithms, work packages, gates, tests, SLOs, risks, and open questions; canonical ID and lower_snake_case vocabulary rules; semantics manifest and traceability generation; validators for uniqueness, references, status vocabulary, schema identity, DAG acyclicity, and claim/evidence honesty; explicit fact/design/hypothesis/target classification.

Binding invariants

Reject stale/mixed generations, non-finite/unbounded numerics, and unsupported authority.

Verification contract
Test families: TEST-043 plus repository-policy golden/negative fixtures. SLOs: SLO-009. Qualification lanes: QL-001 repository-policy. Fault tests must use deterministic fixtures and structured logs recording case/seed, anchor and input roots, source/toolchain/model/policy roots, host profile, step/state transitions, timings/budgets, output digests, omissions, recovery, and terminal verdict. Unit/property/differential tests cover pure semantics; end-to-end scripts exercise the public agent/CLI path and verify no leaked descendants or partial authority.

Risks and unresolved decisions
Risks: RISK-006, RISK-007. Open questions: OPEN-018. Resolve choices with evidence and register the decision before implementation; uncertainty narrows claims rather than being hidden.

Current evidence boundary
Registry status is draft. Source presence or design prose is not qualification. Keep this epic open until GATE-000 is earned and update IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS in the same change. Registered predecessors: none.
acceptance_criteria: GATE-000 (Constitution frozen): Registries parse, stable IDs are unique, dependency policy passes, and no implementation claim exceeds evidence. Completion also requires passing the named unit/property/differential, fault, and end-to-end evidence; retained current local receipts; negative evidence; and a status/registry/docs reconciliation with no overclaim.

title: WP-021: Coverage and next-best-view
description:
Outcome
Compute surface coverage, detectability, view-angle, baseline, resolution, and capture suggestions for a manual pilot.

Why this package exists
Coverage is required proof for completeness and absence. Guidance is authority-free advice to a manual pilot and must distinguish proposed, acknowledged, observed maneuver, usable evidence, and question resolution.

Required deliverables
Surface/voxel/view-cell coverage and detectability witnesses; observation count, angle, baseline, resolution, occlusion, texture, material/dynamic and uncertainty factors; certifiable completeness and named excluded/unknown regions; deterministic evidence-deficit ranking; candidate next-best-view poses and human-readable manual capture suggestions with expected information gain, risk/cost, done/abort conditions and do-nothing option; no autonomous command dispatch.

Binding invariants
Preserve immutable originals and raw observations, exact compatible anchors, explicit frames/units/scale/clock/calibration/privacy/coverage, stable canonical ordering, typed errors and recovery, and reserve -> materialize -> verify -> publish. All async work is Asupersync-region owned with &Cx and terminal drain/reconcile/finalize. Models and derived projections are authority-free; safe Rust/closed dependencies/process-sidecar boundaries remain intact; public schemas use canonical lower_snake_case and fdgr.<name>/1. Reject stale/mixed generations, non-finite/unbounded values, unsupported authority, and partial publication.

Verification contract
Test families: TEST-016, TEST-027, TEST-029, TEST-032, TEST-041. SLOs: SLO-002, SLO-005, SLO-020. Qualification lanes: QL-011 semantic-coverage, QL-021 agent-ergonomics. Logs retain case/seed, exact anchors and input/source/toolchain/model/policy roots, host/profile, state transitions, timings/budgets, output digests, omissions, recovery and terminal verdict; verify cancellation leaves no descendants and negative evidence remains visible.

Risks and unresolved decisions
Risks: RISK-013, RISK-017, RISK-022. Open questions: OPEN-021, OPEN-024. Register evidence-backed decisions before implementation and preserve a reference/fallback lane when research or integration is rejected.

Current evidence boundary
Registry status is planned; design/source presence is not qualification. Registered predecessors: WP-013, WP-020. Keep open until GATE-010 and update IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS with earned/lost capability.

Turn frame/ray/mask/geometry observations into ontology-bound hypotheses and carefully resolved assets. Multi-view consistency, counterevidence, topology, detectability, critical-asset review, and calibrated uncertainty prevent captions from becoming facts.

Normative packages: WP-022..WP-023. Registered acceptance span: GATE-011. This epic is organizational; the WP epics and their explicit blocker edges remain the execution authority.

Every child package must preserve exact anchors, stable ordering, typed errors/recovery, immutable originals, reserve-materialize-verify-publish, Asupersync region ownership, closed dependency/unsafe policy, agent Turn Packet projection, deterministic fixtures, structured end-to-end logging, local qualification receipts, and contemporaneous IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS updates. Negative evidence and research-only boundaries remain visible.
acceptance_criteria: Every normative package in WP-022..WP-023 has a complete self-contained task decomposition, all registered predecessor edges are represented, and each package closes only on its own registered terminal gate with retained local evidence.

title: WP-022: Semantic ontology and observations
description:

Define home-asset ontology and produce Qwen and segmentation observations tied to frames, rays, masks, and geometry.

Why this package exists
A caption or mask is an Observation, not a Resolved asset. Ontology specificity must not exceed available data, and hidden utilities are not observed facts.
